name: Newmark Group, Inc.
summary: Newmark Group, Inc. operates as a commercial real estate advisor and service provider in the United States, the United Kingdom, Asia, rest of Europe, and other Americas. The company offers capital markets services consisting of investment sales, including placement and raising of equity; and commercial mortgage brokerage, such as government-sponsored enterprises (GSEs) and federal housing administration (FHA) lending, as well as the placement of debt, loan sales, and structured finance on behalf of third parties. It also provides landlord or agency representation leasing; GSEs and FHA multifamily loan servicing, as well as limited loan servicing, special loan servicing, and asset management;…
